housing_building_stock_character: Major metropolitan activity centre with its own CBD; building stock ranges from post-war Housing Commission housing (Box Hill South) to a recent boom in high-rise residential and commercial towers clustered around the station — home to the tallest buildings outside central Melbourne. Large Chinese community (46.6% Chinese ancestry, 2021).
source_quotes: Box Hill is an eastern suburb of Melbourne, Victoria, Australia, 14 kilometres (8.7 mi) east of the city's Central Business District (CBD), located within the City of Whitehorse local government area. Box Hill recorded a population of 14,353 at the 2021 census.

Today, Box Hill is notable for its large Chinese community ... (the 2021 census recorded 46.6% of the suburb's residents as having Chinese ancestry), and is home to the city's tallest high-rise buildings outside the CBD.
Post-war housing expansion included a Housing Commission estate in Box Hill South.

More recently, Box Hill has experienced a construction boom, and is now home to high-rise buildings ... the 36-storey Sky One, standing at 122 metres tall, which is the tallest building outside central Melbourne.
Box Hill railway station forms the core of the central area. Taller residential and commercial buildings are clustered around this area
